comments.author: veryalien
comments.content:
As I wrote for the earlier blog post, it's working great on my android phone.
One minor gripe is that you can 'try' commands for previous rooms by scrolling back. But the commands are still handled or rejected correctly.
For the initial 'mobile' version I'd say that's pretty damn good!

comments.author: Anthony
comments.content: I have downloaded Bump for iPhone. Is it possible to reload a saved game manually? If not, please add this sorely needed feature!
